concerns.text: Task T007 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it mutates global RNG state via `set_global_seed(seed)`. Parallel execution of other tasks that rely on randomness could be affected, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

Task T051 validates `final_analysis_data_all.csv` against `dataset.schema.yaml`, which requires a `visual_complexity` column. No preceding task creates or populates this column (e.g., a composite visual‑complexity score), so the consumer expects an artifact that is never produced, constituting a producer‑before‑consumer ordering violation.
